mission: Edubuzz = search engine for OFFICIAL South African jobs. Apply URL must always be the employer's official application page. No third-party job boards.

confidence_legend.verified: URL/ATS confirmed via web research this session
confidence_legend.high: Well-established public evidence; ATS pattern standard for this platform/host
confidence_legend.likely: Strong sector/company signal but ATS not directly confirmed
confidence_legend.medium: Reasonable estimate from sector norms; confirm at connector-build time
confidence_legend.low: Placeholder; requires live verification before building

field_notes: ats_platform, js_required, playwright_required, jsonld, est_active_vacancies, pagination and anti_bot are ROADMAP estimates to be confirmed by inspecting each employer's live listings page during connector build (per the official-source policy, never fabricate).

generic_connectors.description: Greenhouse public Job Board API - one connector serves ALL Greenhouse employers.
generic_connectors.notes: JSON, no auth, no JS. Apply URL is the employer's Greenhouse board (official). Verified employers: Takealot (takealotcom).

generic_connectors.description: Lever postings API - one connector serves ALL Lever employers.
SmartRecruiters Posting API - one connector serves ALL SmartRecruiters employers.
generic_connectors.notes: Verified employers: Deloitte (Deloitte6), OUTsurance (OUTsurance), Standard Bank (partnership confirmed; token TBD).

generic_connectors.description: Workday CXS JSON endpoint - one connector serves MANY large employers (per-tenant config).
generic_connectors.notes: Public CXS JSON. Requires per-employer {tenant}/{dc}/{site} discovery (one-time). Verified tenant host: Absa (absa.wd3).

generic_connectors.description: SAP SuccessFactors career sites - common across SA corporates/SOEs. Config per tenant; some expose OData/JSON-LD, others need render.
generic_connectors.api_pattern: career-site specific (OData Recruiting API or rendered career site, e.g. careerNN.successfactors.eu/career?company={tenant})
generic_connectors.notes: Heterogeneous. Verified tenants: SA Post Office (postofficeP2). Prioritise tenants that emit JobPosting JSON-LD (use structured_html).

generic_connectors.description: schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD extraction (already implemented). Works on ANY career/detail page that embeds JobPosting, regardless of ATS.
generic_connectors.notes: Cheapest official extraction; try before Playwright/Firecrawl.

generic_connectors.description: Oracle iRecruitment / PeopleSoft HR portals - common in the SA higher-education sector.
generic_connectors.notes: Candidate employers: UCT, Wits (irec.wits.ac.za). Often needs render.

generic_connectors.description: Firecrawl clean extraction + AI normalization for custom/gov/PDF sources with no API/feed/JSON-LD. Per-site config; last resort.
generic_connectors.notes: Use for DPSA circular (PDF), municipalities, universities without JSON-LD.

generic_connectors.description: Headless-browser rendering for JS portals: pagination, infinite scroll, Load More, cookie banners. Feeds Firecrawl/JSON-LD extraction. Adds ~300MB browser dep.
generic_connectors.notes: Install only when first dynamic portal is scheduled.

generic_connectors.description: NOT a connector. Marks recruitment agencies / third-party sources that conflict with the official-employer-only policy (they mask the true employer and apply URL).
generic_connectors.notes: Documented for completeness. Do NOT import unless the source exposes the employer's own official apply URL.
